final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss
* tail switch
Mt   tail clk  vss  vss nfet W=4  L=0.15
* input pair
M1   x1   vinp tail vss nfet W=4 L=0.15
M2   x2   vinn tail vss nfet W=4 L=0.15
* cross-coupled latch
M3   l1   l2   x1   vss nfet W=2  L=0.15
M4   l2   l1   x2   vss nfet W=2  L=0.15
M5   l1   l2   vdd  vdd pfet W=2  L=0.15
M6   l2   l1   vdd  vdd pfet W=2  L=0.15
* reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
M7   l1   clk  vdd  vdd pfet W=1  L=0.15
M8   l2   clk  vdd  vdd pfet W=1  L=0.15
M9   x1   clk  vdd  vdd pfet W=1 L=0.15
M10  x2   clk  vdd  vdd pfet W=1 L=0.15
* output inverters (reset: both outputs low)
M11  outp l1   vss  vss nfet W=1 L=0.15
M12  outp l1   vdd  vdd pfet W=2 L=0.15
M13  outn l2   vss  vss nfet W=1 L=0.15
M14  outn l2   vdd  vdd pfet W=2 L=0.15
.ends dut
